_evidence: 0x0053cb67 (initial selection when a menu opens, called by 0x53c8fa after 0x53ca9a stored the item count [0x82fd52]): 'mov esi,[0x82fd34]; movzx ecx,byte [esi+0xf]; or ecx,ecx; jne; movzx ecx,byte [esi+0xd]' gives sel (+0xd is the saved selection: 0x53ca72 stores [0x82fd45] there on close, 0 when it was 0xff; 0x54fd0d/0x5467ee.. store 1), [0x82fd45] = sel, ecx = max(sel,1), clamped to 1 (after the assert stub 0x54e232) when above [0x82fd52]; then 'mov esi,[esi]; loop' hops ecx links, and the search tests +0x1e bit 0x40 and +0x1f bits 0x20/0x10 (qualifies: stop), else follows +0 (null -> first item [[0x82fd34]]) until 'cmp dl=[esi+0xc],[0x82fd45]' matches (back at the selection: assert stub, first item). Termination needs sel to be an item id or some item to qualify, otherwise the original loops forever. Two menus: (1) the static 13-item menu 0x84300a (items 0x843040..0x8430fe stride 0x26 and 0x843128..0x843224 stride 0x2a, ids +0xc = 1..13, item 13 links to 0; links and ids never written) with sel always an id: +0xf {0,1,3,7,12,13} and +0xd {1,2,5,12,13} (13 with [0x82fd52] = 12 takes the clamp, then the walk tests items 1..12 and matches id 13 at item 13), item flags +0x1e with bit 0x40 in half the draws and +0x1f with bits 0x30 clear in 0.4 of them (qualifying probability 0.2, so 'no item qualifies' - the wrap and the id-match path - occurs in several percent of the cases); (2) a synthetic three-item menu in the unreferenced bss block 0xa21000 (header +0 = 0xa21040, items 0xa21040 -> 0xa21080 -> 0xa210c0 -> 0, ids 1/2/3) whose header has +0xd = 0 and +0xf in {0, 14, 20}: sel 0 (the 'ecx = 0 -> 1' block 0x53cb84) or above the count is not an id, so the original only terminates when an item qualifies - the menu code is only entered with a selectable item - and its last item is selectable (+0x1e 0x40, +0x1f 0) while the first two draw the same flags as above. [0x82fd34] is 0x84300a in 3/4 of the cases, [0x82fd52] 12 or 13 (13 items exist, so up to 13 hops never reach a null link). Values are synthetic.
